boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Penn Libraries study environments spanning quiet desks, reservable group rooms, booths, and technology-equipped spaces.

cards.title: Rosengarten Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt-Dietrich Library Center, ground floor
cards.notes: Set up at one of 24 desks with power sockets when you want a designated quiet-study setting; use the library floor plan to orient yourself.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor quiet area with desks and power.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists 24 seats and photographs desks with power sockets in this ground-floor Van Pelt-Dietrich quiet-study area.
cards.source_title: Rosengarten Quiet Study Area | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the Van Pelt-Dietrich ground floor; library hours apply. The page documents accessible routes and nearby accessible restrooms.

cards.title: Brownlee Group Study Suite
cards.subtitle: G101.2 and G101.3, Van Pelt-Dietrich Library Center
cards.notes: Reserve a four-seat room for a small working session, and use the in-room whiteboard to sketch a plan or divide up a problem set.
cards.short_summary: Two reservable, four-seat ground-floor rooms with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries identifies Brownlee as rooms G101.2 and G101.3, each seating four and equipped with a whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Brownlee Group Study Suite | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: Ground-floor Van Pelt-Dietrich rooms; reserve a room through Penn Libraries. The page notes accessible circulation and nearby accessible restrooms.

cards.title: Stovall/Dickey Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: G101.1, Van Pelt-Dietrich Library Center
cards.notes: Book this four-seat room for a focused meeting and put the chalkboard to work for timelines, equations, or a shared outline.
cards.short_summary: A reservable four-seat room with a chalkboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists the Stovall/Dickey room at G101.1 with four seats, a chalkboard, and a room-reservation link.
cards.source_title: Stovall/Dickey Group Study Room | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Penn Libraries; food is not permitted and covered drinks are permitted. Accessible circulation details are listed on the page.

cards.title: Weigle Group Study Suite
cards.subtitle: Rooms 403 and 404, Van Pelt-Dietrich Library Center
cards.notes: Reserve one of these sixth-floor-scale group rooms—actually on the fourth floor—and use its chalkboard when your work benefits from a shared surface.
cards.short_summary: Two fourth-floor rooms for groups of six, each with a chalkboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists rooms 403 and 404 on Van Pelt-Dietrich's fourth floor, with six seats per room and a chalkboard.
cards.source_title: Weigle Group Study Suite | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve a room through Penn Libraries. The page documents fourth-floor location, accessible circulation, and nearby accessible restrooms.

cards.title: WIC Group Study Rooms 117–120
cards.subtitle: Weigle Information Commons, Van Pelt-Dietrich first floor
cards.notes: Use a reservable room for a group of four to six when an iMac, articulated monitor, whiteboard, or video-conference camera supports the task.
cards.short_summary: Four technology-equipped, reservable WIC group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists rooms 117–120 in WIC with seating for four to six, iMacs, articulated monitors, whiteboards, and cameras.
cards.source_title: WIC Group Study Rooms 117 - 120 | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: First-floor WIC rooms; reserve through Penn Libraries. Non-aromatic food and drink are allowed, and accessibility information is provided.

cards.entity_name: Study Booths in the Weigle Information Commons
cards.title: Study Booths in the Weigle Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt-Dietrich Library Center, first floor west
cards.notes: Reserve a booth when six people need a contained setup with a computer workstation; check the room-or-booth reservation tool before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Reservable WIC booths with computer workstations and six seats each.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists 12 WIC study and consultation booths, each seating six and equipped with a computer workstation, iMac, and PC desktop.
cards.source_title: Study booths in the Weigle Information Commons | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: First-floor-west WIC; use the Penn Libraries reservation link. Non-aromatic food and drink are allowed in this area.

cards.entity_name: Education Commons Small Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Education Commons Small Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Rooms 228–231, Education Commons at Franklin Field
cards.notes: Reserve one of these four- or five-seat rooms when a shared screen, desktop computer, and whiteboard will keep a small project moving.
cards.short_summary: Four compact Education Commons rooms with screens, PCs, and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists rooms 228–231 with four or five seats, a 46-inch screen, integrated computer system, PC desktop, and whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Education Commons Small Group Study Rooms | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: On the mezzanine of George A. Weiss Pavilion in Franklin Field; reserve through Penn Libraries. Accessible bathroom information is listed.

cards.entity_name: Education Commons Group Study Rooms for 10
cards.title: Education Commons Group Study Rooms for 10
cards.subtitle: Rooms 225, 226, and 235, Education Commons
cards.notes: Plan a larger working session here when a presentation screen, integrated computer system, desktop PC, and whiteboard suit the agenda.
cards.short_summary: Three reservable Education Commons rooms built for groups of ten.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists rooms 225, 226, and 235 with ten seats per room, an 80-inch screen, integrated computer system, PC desktop, and whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Education Commons Group Study Rooms for 10 | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Penn Libraries; the page provides accessible-entry and accessible-bathroom information for Education Commons.

cards.entity_name: Holman Biotech Commons 6-Seat Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Holman Biotech Commons 6-Seat Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Johnson Pavilion and Stemmler Hall, main level
cards.notes: Reserve a six-seat room for a working group, especially if adjustable office chairs and a dedicated table fit the way your team studies.
cards.short_summary: Reservable main-level group rooms with a table, computer, and six office chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists group rooms 1, 4, 8, 10–13, 15, 19, and 20 with six seats; each contains a table, six office chairs, and a computer.
cards.source_title: Holman Biotech Commons: 6-seat group study rooms | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: Main level of Johnson Pavilion and Stemmler Hall; reserve through Penn Libraries. Food is not permitted; covered drinks are permitted.

cards.title: Holman Biotech Commons Study Alcoves
cards.subtitle: Johnson Pavilion, Holman Biotech Commons main level
cards.notes: Choose an alcove when lounge seating and two tables fit your session; keep food out and bring only a covered beverage if needed.
cards.short_summary: Three named alcoves pairing tables with lounge seats.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Libraries lists the Gliklich, Polan, and Crowley Family Study Alcoves in Johnson Pavilion, with two tables and four lounge seats per alcove.
cards.source_title: Holman Biotech Commons: Study Alcoves | Penn Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Holman Biotech Commons' main level. Food is not permitted; beverages must be covered. The page lists accessible entry and restroom details.
